text: Prompt was just "add the next slice" again with no capability named, and — unlike the Cancel Reservation case — there's no obvious visual cue (like a leftover button) pointing to what comes after cancelling a reservation. Added an empty placeholder slice here; let me know what should happen next in this flow (e.g. a confirmation, a notification, or something else) so it can be named and fleshed out. Also note: this platform only allows forward connections (earlier column → later column), so an EVENT here can't feed back into the earlier "Reservations" read model — if the list needs to reflect cancellations, that likely needs its own new read-model slice rather than a backward edge.
